title: The Sanctity of Blood

questions.question: Where did the Israelites have to bring their sacrifices?
options: To the entrance of the tent of meeting
questions.correctAnswer: To the entrance of the tent of meeting
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:4 (ESV): "And does not bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting... bloodguilt shall be imputed to that man."

questions.question: To whom were the sacrifices to be offered?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:5 (ESV): "And sacrifice them to the Lord."

questions.question: What were they no longer to sacrifice to?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:7 (ESV): "So they shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to goat demons, after whom they whore."

questions.question: What substance was strictly forbidden to eat?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:10 (ESV): "If any one... eats any blood, I will set my face against that person... and will cut him off."

questions.question: Why is blood forbidden?
options: For the life of the flesh is in the blood
questions.correctAnswer: For the life of the flesh is in the blood
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:11 (ESV): "For the life of the flesh is in the blood, and I have given it for you on the altar to make atonement."

questions.question: What must a hunter do after catching an animal or bird?
options: Pour out its blood and cover it with earth
questions.correctAnswer: Pour out its blood and cover it with earth
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:13 (ESV): "He shall pour out its blood and cover it with earth."

questions.question: What makes atonement for the soul?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:11 (ESV): "For it is the blood that makes atonement by the life."

questions.question: What if someone killed an ox, lamb, or goat inside or outside the camp without bringing it to the tent?
options: He was considered guilty of bloodshed
questions.correctAnswer: He was considered guilty of bloodshed
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:4 (ESV): "Bloodguilt shall be imputed to that man; he has shed blood, and that man shall be cut off from among his people."

questions.question: What happens to the person who eats what dies of itself or is torn by beasts?
options: He shall wash his clothes and bathe and be unclean until evening
questions.correctAnswer: He shall wash his clothes and bathe and be unclean until evening
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:15 (ESV): "He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening; then he shall be clean."

questions.question: Why did God centralize worship at the tent of meeting?
options: To end sacrifices to goat demons in the open fields
questions.correctAnswer: To end sacrifices to goat demons in the open fields
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:5, 7 implies the purpose was to stop them from sacrificing in the open field to idols (goat demons).

questions.question: Who did these laws apply to?
options: The house of Israel and the strangers who sojourn among them
questions.correctAnswer: The house of Israel and the strangers who sojourn among them
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:8 (ESV): "Any one of the house of Israel or of the strangers who sojourn among them..."

questions.question: If a man did not wash his clothes after eating a torn animal, what happened?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:16 (ESV): "But if he does not wash them or bathe his flesh, he shall bear his iniquity."

questions.question: The prohibition on blood applied to what food sources?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:13 (ESV): "Catches any beast or bird that may be eaten..."

questions.question: What is the "life" of all flesh identified as?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:14 (ESV): "For the life of every creature is its blood: its blood is its life."

questions.question: The peace offerings were to be sacrificed where?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:5 (ESV): "Bring them to the Lord... at the entrance of the tent of meeting... and sacrifice them as peace offerings."

key_verse_text: For the life of the flesh is in the blood, and I have given it for you on the altar to make atonement for your souls, for it is the blood that makes atonement by the life.
